# 287_R6FIX.24 — HSTS unconditional on deployed images (BL-135)

## Summary

- **Item (BL-135, INFO):** HSTS stamped only when `x-forwarded-proto === "https"` or a raw
  `https://` URL — a deployed hop missing the forwarded header got no stamp; the header is the
  fragile dependency.
- **Fix (api + web):** the image-baked deploy SHA (`buildGitSha` — the JOURNEY.1 provenance value)
  makes the stamp unconditional on deployed images; off-image (dev/tests) the TLS-signal gate is
  unchanged, preserving the D-R6SECR.1-2 disposition and RFC 6797's insecure-transport posture.
- Same policy value everywhere (`max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains`, no preload).
